subject: build.sh now runs both integration test suits (#298)
reason: The change is purely build/CI/test infrastructure: build.sh now also runs the OSS integration suite (with retries), shell helpers moved into scripts/common.rc (setup_valkey_server, setup_json_module, install_test_framework, check_for_san_errors), .gitignore entries were added, and the Python integration tests were reformatted and de-flaked (waiters.wait_for_equal replacing sleeps, Union type hints). No file under the module's runtime source is touched, so the module binary's behaviour — commands, replies, indexing, cluster or persistence paths — is identical at the change and its parent. There
